Title: Aarav and the Family

Cast

1. Aarav - 8 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Meenakshi - 36 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Karan - 38 years, father
Look: white kurta-pyjama

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Aarav stands in the living room. Meenakshi and Karan stand near him.]

Karan: "Today feels like a good day."

[Aarav reads a storybook.]

Aarav (softly): "Slowly, take it easy."

[Aarav writes in his notebook.]

Aarav: "Let's see."

[Aarav talks to his father on the phone.]

Aarav: "And then?"

[Aarav's phone rings and he answers it.]

Aarav: "Show me too!"

[Aarav types on his laptop.]

Aarav: "What next?"

[Aarav watches cartoons on TV.]

Aarav: "This is amazing!"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Aarav is sitting on a chair in the living room. Meenakshi stands near him.]

Aarav: "Let's begin."

[Aarav stands up.]

Aarav: "Yes, of course."

Scene 3: The courtyard - Day

Aarav: "Let's begin."

[Aarav dances to the music.]

Aarav (happily): "One more time!"

[Aarav sings a song.]

Aarav: "Careful!"

[Aarav waves goodbye to Mother.]

Aarav (gently): "Slowly, take it easy."

[Aarav thinks for a moment.]

Aarav: "What a day to remember!"
